_about: lanePITSHOVE: Pitborn's free-LEFT-hand shove (ShoveTable.cs, AIBrain hook, Duel.Resolve hook). MASTER 'enabled' false = today's fight bit for bit (no row read, no RNG draw, no new branch taken; the move row in move-defs.json is only a lookup entry). rows[] = who may use it and when: the AI of the named character (roster id / object name, RosterResolver) starts it only when ALL hold: the move is legal now (idle or guarding, stamina >= minStamina, not exhausted), the foe is in foePhases, no noticed swing is being answered (requireNoThreat), the foe has been within crowdM of him for crowdTicks sim ticks in a row (he is being crowded) and is now between triggerMinM and triggerMaxM (centre to centre, metres, the unit of DodgeTable.minSeparation 1.5), the cooldown is over, and a roll of its OWN seeded stream (not the AI's s.Roll: no existing draw moves) succeeds (chance; a failed roll is retried after retryTicks, not every tick). moves[] of a row = the pick table (weighted); moves[] at the top = per-move sim numbers: pushToM = the centre distance the clean hit pushes the foe out to (a knock velocity is derived from the stagger length and knockDecay, clamped to minPushM..maxPushM of travel), nonLethal = this move never kills (health is set back to 1 when it would reach 0), location = the hit_reactions.json location key. Damage, stagger, knockback fallback, reach, windup / active / recovery, direction (thrust: guard sides centre / top and the shield's left guard cover it, controls.json guard.match + gear.json joan_shield.shield.cover) and stamina are the MOVE ROW in move-defs.json. knockDecay = the per-tick factor of DuelFighter.MoveTick's knock slide (0.88 today; if laneDATALAYER b2 moves it to rules-defs, set the same value here). Command line: -shove:off (force off), -shove:on (force on for character rows), -shove:log.
